title: Sample: dictionaries and a guard function

questions.question: What is the difference between d["key"] and d.get("key") when the key is missing?
questions.answer: d["key"] stops the program with a KeyError. d.get("key") gives None and carries on.

questions.question: Which line is True?
questions.why: Only "7" is text. 7 is a number and [7] is a list.
